beats.headline: More than one voice in there
beats.text: Florin says there are several presences in her head, other children among them, and that the dog is the key to it.

beats.headline: The count
beats.text: Zev puts a number on it: about 120,000 children, give or take. Their bodies are in the kinder facility on the surface; the rest of them is bound up in her head, and if she goes, they may all go.

beats.headline: Azra asks for her father
beats.text: Lucia steps back, shrinks, and somebody else is looking out of her face. A girl, Azra, with her sister Yaz beside her, crying: the shining lady says Carl knows her father, that he gave Carl a spell. He owns a bowling alley. Carl tells her he is safe and loves her. She says the angel lady keeps talking about people coming to take their bodies, and that it is cold. When Florin asks who, she runs.
